title: The 240 s admission window starts at first acceptance, so a Defer or a long pre-hold wait can spend it before prepared-Begin recovery begins
outcome: The coordinator decides, and the brief records, whether the prepared-Begin recovery window keeps starting when the head is first accepted (as w-cfcf10b68c9b's C4 specifies) or restarts at the first prepared-Begin hold (held_since) or after a definitive Defer. If it changes, the code and tests change with it. If it stays, docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md states the consequence: an unrelated Defer or a long wait before the hold can leave little or no automatic recovery time.
acceptance: The coordinator's ruling (keep the start at acceptance, or restart it at held_since or a definitive Defer) is recorded on the item.
docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md describes the chosen start and its consequence for heads that waited before entering prepared-Begin recovery.
If the start changes, a scripted-clock test shows a head that was deferred or waited before its first hold still gets the specified recovery window, and existing C4 tests are updated to match.
